# storage/scan's ClamAV image is behind the `integration` build tag, which the
# CI test job does not set, so it is deliberately absent. Split-module emulator

# absent too.

# This lives in its own file, not inline in ci.yml, because the CI image cache
# is keyed on its hash: edit the list and the next run repopulates the cache.
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
